author: Yffe
content:
FIXED (#130): the generated byte-view FREE fns are now minted under the RESERVED prefix __thermite_, so a user spec fn named like a generated helper is a DISTINCT name — no double definition (E0428), even when the generated module is genuinely pulled in via a non-shadowed trigger.

Commit 87e9677. Single concern; thermite-lower/src/lower.rs (the reserved scheme) + thermite-spec/src/validator.rs (the prefix-reservation rule).

Reserved scheme:
- prefix __thermite_; renamed FREE fns: is_digit/all_digits/parse_be/parse_le/pow10/seq_reverse (C4/C7) + occurs_at/contains_sub/count_sep/sep_free/is_space (C5) + exec parse_u64/u64_to_string + the proof lemmas. The TString METHODS (matches_at/starts_with/split/...) are inherent (namespaced under the impl) — not reserved.
- reserve_generated_names (whole-identifier rewrite) applied to emit_parse_defs/emit_numfmt_defs/emit_string_search_defs + the search methods → the generated module DEFINES and INTER-CALLS the reserved names (parse_u64 body calls __thermite_is_digit, etc.).
- call-site rewrite in lower_expr: a callee resolving to a generated free fn (GENERATED_FREE_FNS, NOT a user String spec fn via is_user_string_spec_fn) is rewritten to its reserved name — covers user contract refs (ens parse_be(result) == n, count_sep(s,sep)) + exec parse_u64(s)/n.to_string().
- byteview dispatch (callee_takes_string_byteview) + sep_fn/occurs_fn key on the SURFACE name (un-rewritten callee Expr), UNCHANGED — a String arg to __thermite_all_digits routes to .data@; a user all_digits(&String) passes the ref.
- VALIDATOR reserves the prefix: SpecError::ReservedName rejects a user fn/spec fn declaring a __thermite_* name (the surface permits the identifier, so it is forbidden here).

Confirmation: a user is_digit(&String)/count_sep(&String) + genuine parse_u64(s)/s.split(sep) → exactly 1 user def + 1 reserved generated def, no name twice, compiles, L3 (divergence_byteview_collide_doubledef un-ignored, 2 passed). Generated features still work: string_search/string_format/option_result/#126/#127/editor_runs/acceptance_programs all green/L3. Golden parse_u64.verus.rs updated to reserved names (verifies standalone). divergence_numfmt_zero (#97) L3 search string updated to __thermite_u64_to_string (L1 runtime is a separate self-consistent namespace, bare names, no collision).

Gauntlet: build OK; cargo test --workspace 675 passed/0 failed/0 ignored; clippy -D warnings PASS; fmt --check PASS. Closes the byteview name-collision class. No conformance/ edits (R-CHAR-3).
